summary_rationale: Alphabet exhibits elite structural business quality across two scaled compounding engines: Google Services ($342.7B FY2025 revenue, 40.7% operating margin; $96.3B Q3 2026 revenue, 40.7% margin) and Google Cloud ($58.7B FY2025 revenue, 23.7% margin, accelerating to $30.7B in Q3 2026 at +103% YoY and 36.2% operating margin with a $561B backlog). Consolidated ROIC stands at 28.67% with 60.86% gross margin and 32.0% FY2025 operating margin. Both federal antitrust trials (Search and AdTech) concluded with behavioral, data-sharing, and interoperability remedies rather than structural breakups of Chrome, Android, or AdX. However, KPI health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unqualified pass because 2026 capital expenditure surged to $131.9B through Q3 (guided to $195B–$205B for full-year 2026, up from $91.4B in FY2025 and $52.5B in FY2024), pushing Q3 2026 free cash flow negative (-$9.07B) and lifting long-term debt from $46.5B to $125.1B while Other Bets losses widened to $7.5B in FY2025 and $2.05B in Q3 2026.
